requires.degrade: Without node, the prerequisites checker cannot run and no dependency is verified; the plugin's own skills are unaffected.

Without jq, /attribution:audit leaves its config layers unread and audits with the defaults, and fetch-docs.sh and docs-cache.sh exit before reading anything, so a source page is read by the rung-2 fallback instead.

Without curl, fetch-docs.sh records a source page unread with reason curl-missing, so /attribution:audit reads it by the rung-2 fallback, which cannot ground an absence; a cached entry still within --max-age is served without a request.
Without Python 3, a source page that serves only HTML cannot be converted and is recorded unread with reason no-python; pages served as markdown read normally.
